// Compile a captured target from begin through EOF. Arguments belong to
// c_program. Complete all target work before returning its process status.
fn c_build(target: *RmdSource, begin: usize, argument_count: i32, arguments: **u8) -> i32 {
    var context_value: RmdContext = uninit;
    rmd_context_init(&context_value, null(*RmdAllocator));
    var request: RmdBuild = make RmdBuild {
        context: &context_value, source: target, target_begin: begin,
        argc: argument_count, argv: arguments
    };
    var status_value: i32 = c_program(&request);
    if context_value.error_count != 0usize { rmd_run_diagnostic(&context_value); }
    rmd_context_destroy(&context_value);
    return status_value;
}
